provenance.construction: Reconstructed from qecdb.org record 67a3896e9d65c7b409826887 (https://qecdb.org/codes/67a3896e9d65c7b409826887); the record's H field is read as binary symplectic rows and split by rowspace (rank(A|B) = rank(A) + rank(B)), keeping the lightest independent basis of each part; n, k and the check weight recomputed here, witnesses from the kit's random search at the trials below. Database description: 2BGA; database distance claim d=3 (lower 3, upper 3).
provenance.notes: Equivalence assessed against the board: no exact stabilizer-group fingerprint match and no Weisfeiler-Leman signature match to any existing entry. Filed as `codes/24-8-3-b.json`, a lighter-check companion to `codes/24-8-3.json` (same [[24,8,3]], max check weight 6 vs 7).

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.
